ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב שָׁלַח אֶת בָּנָיו לְחַפֵּשׂ אֹכֶל, אֲבָל דָּאַג מְאֹד לְבִנְיָמִין.
ideas.children_en: Jacob heard there was food in Egypt and Joseph sold grain to foreigners. He sent his sons to buy grain to live but did not send Benjamin because he feared harm might come to him.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף זִהָה אֶת אֶחָיו, אֲבָל הֵם לֹא זִהוּ אוֹתוֹ.
ideas.children_en: Joseph was in charge of selling grain in Egypt. He recognized his brothers but acted strict to test them. They didn't recognize him because he looked different and was now a ruler.

ideas.children_he: הָאַחִים נֶאֱלְצוּ לְהַסְבִּיר מִי הֵם וּמַדּוּעַ בָּאוּ.
ideas.children_en: Joseph accused his brothers of spying, but they said they were simple men and honest. They told about their family, but Joseph doubted them because their story had too many details.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף בָּחַן אֶת אֶחָיו וְדָרַשׁ שֶׁיָּבִיאוּ אֶת בִּנְיָמִין.
ideas.children_en: Joseph said he would not free them until they brought Benjamin. He kept the brothers jailed to prove they were not spies. He gave them food and they obeyed him.

ideas.children_he: הָאַחִים נִזְכְּרוּ בַּפְּגִיעָה שֶׁפָּגְעוּ בְּיוֹסֵף וְהִרְגִּישׁוּ אַשְׁמָה.
ideas.children_en: The brothers talked and felt what happened was punishment for selling Joseph. They thought Joseph didn't understand, but he heard them and put Simeon in jail.

ideas.children_he: כְּשֶׁמָּצְאוּ אֶת כַּסְפָּם בַּשַּׂקִּים, הָאַחִים נִבְהֲלוּ.
ideas.children_en: Joseph filled the brothers' bags with grain, gave back their money, and gave them food. On the way home, they found the money hidden and felt it was a punishment.

ideas.children_he: הָאַחִים סִפְּרוּ לְאָבִיהֶם עַל הַפְּגִישָׁה הַקָּשָׁה בְּמִצְרַיִם.
ideas.children_en: The brothers came to Jacob and told him everything. They said the ruler spoke to them harshly and accused them of spying.

ideas.children_he: הָאַחִים נִסּוּ לְהַסְבִּיר לַשַּׁלִּיט שֶׁהֵם מִשְׁפָּחָה אַחַת.
ideas.children_en: The brothers said they spoke honestly. They were twelve brothers from one father, with one still at home in Canaan.

ideas.children_he: יוֹסֵף רָצָה לִרְאוֹת אִם הָאַחִים יְקַיְּמוּ אֶת דִּבְרֵיהֶם.
ideas.children_en: The ruler said he would prove they were brothers by keeping one and giving grain to the rest. He also demanded they bring the youngest brother to prove their story.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב פָּחַד לְאַבֵּד גַּם אֶת בִּנְיָמִין.
ideas.children_en: Money was returned to every brother's sack. This scared them. Jacob was afraid to lose Benjamin, the youngest brother who stayed with him.

ideas.children_he: לִפְעָמִים הַפַּחַד מֵאֲבֵדָה קוֹדֶמֶת מַקְשֶׁה עָלֵינוּ לִבְטֹחַ מֵחָדָשׁ.
ideas.children_en: Reuben offered his two sons as guarantee if Benjamin did not return. Jacob refused to send Benjamin, fearing to lose him like Joseph.
